cr_data.provenance:
Collection of the artist, until c. 1942; Alfred Stieglitz (1864‑1946), An American Place, NY, c. 1942‑until d. 1946; estate of Alfred Stieglitz, 1946‑1949 [1]; gift to PMA, 1949. 
 
1. Georgia O’Keeffe was executor for the estate of Alfred Stieglitz and made the selection for the PMA. See letter from Henri Marceau to O'Keeffe on July 7, 1949. 
 
(Source: Philadelphia Museum of Art, 2025)

titles.title: Red Hills and Bones

description: Two animal bones sit at the bottom of the canvas. Extending behind the bones are dark red, orange, and yellow hills dotted with green and white bushes. A large, dark red hill rises above the scene, dwarfed by tall orange cliffs standing behind it.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Philadelphia Museum of Art.
